hook.text: Both partners are healthy. But if both carry the same recessive gene, their child faces a 25% risk.

buildup.text: Carrier screening tests future parents for recessive mutations before pregnancy. Forewarned is forearmed.

discovery.text: Expanded panels now cover over 300 conditions in one test. Cost has dropped below $250.

twist.text: Almost everyone carries 5–10 recessive disease mutations. Universal screening finds risks no family history predicted.

climax.text: Carrier screening is moving from ethnic-targeted panels to universal testing. Every couple can benefit.

punchline.text: Both healthy. Both carriers. Now they know.

quiz.question: How many recessive disease mutations does an average person carry?
